claims.text: SSRIs and TCAs: commonly used for depression, anxiety, OCD in HD, but no convincing evidence documented.
claims.quote: Although selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRI), tricyclic antidepressants are commonly used in Huntington disease for the treatment of depression, anxiety, and obsessive-compulsive disorders, no convincing evidence of their use in Huntington disease has been documented.
